dct_description_sm: Our objectives were: (1) to assess the contribution of particle-associated (PA) bacteria (fraction equal or larger than 3 m) to total bacterial production and their relationships with changing environmental conditions across the Mackenzie Shelf in the Beaufort Sea; (2) to examine how particle-based heterotrophy changes over the annual cycle in the coastal Arctic Ocean; and (3) to determine whether PA bacterial assemblages differ from the free-living (FL) assemblages (fraction <3 m).
dct_subject_sm: Natural sciences -> Colored dissolved organic material (CDOM)
dct_title_s: Spatial and temporal variations of particle-associated bacteria in the Mackenzie Shelf, Beaufort Sea
